solution: Expanding the right-hand side gives $x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz$: the pure cubes appear once each, while every mixed term such as $x(-yz)=-xyz$ occurs exactly three times, so the $xyz$ total is $-3xyz$ and all other cross terms cancel. Verify with $x=2,y=3,z=5$: both sides equal $70$.
hints: Expand the right-hand side term by term.
